details.question: Revenue vs budget by region for 2024
details.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT c.region_id, SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount)) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' GROUP BY c.region_id), b AS (SELECT region_id, SUM(revenue_budget) AS bud FROM budgets WHERE substr(month, 1, 4) = '2024' GROUP BY region_id) SELECT r.region_name, ROUND(a.rev, 2) AS revenue, ROUND(b.bud, 2) AS budget, ROUND(a.rev - b.bud, 2) AS variance FROM regions r JOIN a ON a.region_id = r.region_id JOIN b ON b.region_id = r.region_id ORDER BY variance

details.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' THEN ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount) END) - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' THEN ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount) END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' THEN ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount) END), 1) AS revenue_growth_pct FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed'
